summary: Fix release: OpenID Connect sign-in now works with providers that return email only from userinfo (such as Authelia), first-run setup can no longer replace the secrets of an existing installation, and Next.js is updated for two security advisories.
upgrade_notes: Back up PostgreSQL, private attachments, uploaded branding, and the private configuration volume together. Use this release's pinned Docker Compose asset, preserve existing volumes and deployment settings, then run docker compose pull and docker compose up -d. Database migrations run automatically; an older image alone is not a recovery point.
